name: Regular Planning Commission Meeting - Adjourned
agenda_text:
NOTICE OF ADJOURNMENT

The October 20, 2020 regular meeting of the Planning Commission of the City of Artesia
has been adjourned, due to lack of quorum, to 6:30 p.m. on November 17, 2020, at the
Albert O. Little Community Center 18750 Clarkdale Ave., Artesia, California 90701.

___10/19/2020________  ____________________________________
Date  Fiona Graham, Interim Planning Manager
